title: Vaulting
description: Vaulting mod lets you leap over mobs — sprint towards them and press jump.
body:
![Vaulting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cf89c245589b5d3395ea13df12f6f70a5d038ec.png)
> **Run towards a mob and press jump to leap over it. Works on any mob up to 2.5 blocks tall. They won't hit you during the vault, making it easy to dodge attacks.**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/RDKMpkYzqYU" title="Проигрыватель YouTube" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>





# **What It Does:**
- **Sprint + Jump = Vault** — run at a mob and press jump to perform a dynamic vault over it.
- **They Can’t Touch You** — while sprinting and looking at an enemy, their melee attacks are completely negated. Your sprint won’t break, and you stay invulnerable as you close the distance.

> **A simple parkour addition for Minecraft.**
